items.snippet: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Du gestaltest aktiv den Aufbau und das Wachstum eines neuen Ventures innerhalb von Enpal – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Kundengewinnung. Du entwickelst datengetriebene Go-to-Market-Strategien und setzt Maßnahmen um, die unsere Produkte erfolgreich am Markt positionieren. Du steuerst und optimierst unsere Customer-Acquisition-Kanäle, von Performance Marketing über neue Growth-Kanäle bis hin zu innovativen Akquisitionsansätzen. Du analysierst unseren Funnel, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und testest neue Ansätze, um Conversion Rates zu verbessern und Akquisitionskosten zu senken. Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Zielgruppen, arbeitest an Pricing- und Commercial-Strategien und leitest daraus konkrete Wachstumsmaßnahmen ab. Du baust skalierbare Prozesse und Tools für Marketing, Sales und Commercial Operations auf und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter. Dein Profil Du hast ein sehr erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor/Masterstudium an einer Top-Tier Business School Du hast Lust, unternehmerisch zu denken, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und ein neues Business aktiv mit aufzubauen – unabhängig davon, ob du gerade ins Berufsleben startest oder bereits erste Erfahrungen gesammelt hast. Du bringst erste Erfahrungen in Growth, Marketing, Business Development oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit. Auch relevante Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder eigene Projekte sind willkommen. Du hast ein gutes analytisches Verständnis, arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen und kannst aus Daten konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. Du bist hands-on, probierst gerne neue Dinge aus und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden Schritt vorgibt. Du hast Spaß daran, Probleme strukturiert zu lösen, Hypothesen zu testen und aus Erfolgen wie Misserfolgen zu lernen. Du überzeugst durch Eigeninitiative, Neugier und den Anspruch, Dinge messbar besser zu machen. Was dich erwartet Build something from scratch: Du gestaltest ein neues Venture innerhalb von Enpal aktiv mit und kannst von Anfang an eigene Ideen einbringen. Ownership statt Zuschauerrolle: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen, siehst die direkten Auswirkungen deiner Arbeit und kannst das Wachstum des Ventures maßgeblich mitgestalten. Eine steile Lernkurve: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Unternehmer:innen und Expert:innen zusammen und entwickelst dich fachlich wie persönlich schnell weiter. Vom Konzept zur Umsetzung: Du kannst Ideen schnell testen, Ergebnisse messen und erfolgreiche Ansätze gemeinsam skalieren. Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und pragmatische Lösungen zählen. Dein nächster Entwicklungsschritt: Ob du als Graduate einsteigst oder bereits Erfahrung mitbringst – du bekommst die Möglichkeit, mit dem Venture zu wachsen und zunehmend Verantwortung zu übernehmen. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. Our team pairs deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As an intern, you will have the unique opportunity to learn and grow through hands-on experiences. Your role will involve utilizing our cutting-edge AI deployment tools to develop innovative solutions for our customers, together with more experienced Deployment Engineers.</p> <p>This is not a traditional engineering role where you build everything manually. You will be introduced to AI-augmented and business-focused software delivery: helping specify what needs to be built, learning to direct AI agents to execute, and assisting in validating the results. Connect</em></p> <ul> <li>Conduct customer-facing sessions with experienced Deployment Engineers to discuss ongoing projects, translate strategic objectives into use cases, and receive guidance on best practices.</li> <li>Assist in gathering and organizing relevant data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and consistency for analysis.</li> </ul> <p><em>Build</em></p> <ul> <li>Learn to direct AI deployment agents (like Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards by helping to write clear specifications.</li> <li>Conduct exploratory data analysis, utilizing Celonis and other tools to uncover trends, process inefficiencies, and root causes.</li> <li>Assist in defining the initial solution design blueprint and configuring operational solutions across the platform.</li> </ul> <p><em>Value & Rollout</em></p> <ul> <li>Support the validation of AI-generated outputs for accuracy and business relevance alongside senior team members.</li> <li>Help develop and maintain KPIs to track the success of project initiatives and quantify business impact.</li> <li>Assist in documenting solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and customer handover.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will learn to work with AI agents as your primary tools, focusing on validating and refining their output rather than writing every line of code manually.</li> <li>You will develop foundational specification and context engineering skills to help translate business needs into precise AI instructions.</li> <li>As you navigate a fast-paced environment, you will learn how to adapt quickly to changes and new approaches as AI capabilities evolve.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The databases; knowledge in SQL, Python, or related coding- and/or database query languages.</li> <li>Curiosity and basic familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, coupled with an eagerness to learn prompt/context engineering.</li> <li>Interest in working with customers, along with awesome presentation and communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to demonstrate initiative, work independently, and think outside of the box.</li> <li>Fluent in English and German (any additional language is a plus).</li> <li>At least 5 months of full-time availability.</li> </ul><div items.snippet: <h1>Commercial Planning Senior Associate</h1> <h2>About the team</h2> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="284" data-end="599">The Commercial Planning team sits at the heart of SumUp's commercial engine, turning complex data into the financial insight that shapes how we grow. We partner closely with Sales leaders and commercial teams to make sure our planning is accurate, proactive, and genuinely useful to the people making decisions. In this role, you’ll primarily support our Sales function, owning analytical and planning workstreams while acting as a trusted finance partner to Sales leadership. If you're energised by owning complex models, understanding what drives sales performance, influencing commercial decisions, and being the person stakeholders turn to when they need clarity, this is the role for you.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end revenue and customer acquisition budget (CAB) planning for acquisition channels, building scalable financial models, running scenario analyses, and delivering proactive performance insights to senior stakeholders</li> <li>Act as a primary finance business partner to Sales and commercial leaders, building trusted relationships, embedding financial models into decision-making, and using data to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve performance</li> <li>Conduct deep-dive analysis at country, merchant category, and channel level to surface revenue risks and opportunities, and present findings clearly to senior, non-technical audiences</li> <li>Build business cases and product-level revenue forecasts to support existing and new product growth initiatives</li> <li>Contribute to the migration of commercial planning from spreadsheets to scalable forecasting tools, and help reduce manual effort in month-end reporting workflows</li> <li>Provide day-to-day guidance to an intern and/or analyst, helping them develop their skills and navigate complex analytical tasks</li> </ul> <h2>You'll be great for this role if…</h2> <ul> <li>Act as a primary finance business partner to<strong> </strong>Sales and commercial leaders, building trusted relationships, embedding financial models into decision-making, and using data to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve performance</li> <li>Expert-level financial modelling skills, including multi-driver models and scenario analysis, with advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets</li> <li data-section-id="4vcvp8" data-start="2115" data-end="2270">Proven ability to act as a trusted finance business partner, comfortable challenging and influencing Sales leaders and senior commercial stakeholders</li> <li>Working knowledge of SQL for data extraction and manipulation from large datasets</li> <li>Clear and structured communicator, able to translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable insight for senior non-technical audiences</li> <li>Comfort working in fast-moving environments where priorities shift, and structure is still being built</li> </ul> <h2>Why you should join SumUp</h2> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup</p> <p>🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced</p> <p>🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success</p> <p>📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education</p> <p>💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions</p> <p>🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days</p> <p>🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches</p> <p>🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service</p> <p>🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team</p> <h2>About SumUp</h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.</p> <p>Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.</p> <p>SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Agent team. We are building a platform for creating, publishing, and executing AI-powered agents that help teams automate complex workflows in financial services. The Agents team owns the agent execution runtime, tool orchestration, and platform infrastructure that makes this possible, including the conversational copilot experiences built on top of it across the product. We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and ship production features across this entire stack, from the agent runtime and tool orchestration layer in the backend, to the conversational copilot experiences users interact with every day. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real product impact from day one, and grow your skills in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment. What You'll Do Build and ship features end-to-end for Taktile's AI agent platform: backend in Python (FastAPI) on AWS serverless infrastructure, and frontend in React and TypeScript. Build conversational copilot experiences end to end: chat UI components, streaming responses, rich in-chat interactions, and human-in-the-loop approvals. Improve how agents run, how they connect to external tools, and how they behave when something goes wrong. Own your work end-to-end: collaborate on scope, implement, test, release, and iterate based on real usage and customer feedback. Use leading-edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to move faster, improve quality, and build AI-native capabilities where it makes sense. Review pull requests with depth, improve test coverage and CI/CD, and raise the bar on reliability and engineering excellence. Engage actively in team rituals such as daily syncs, planning sessions, demos, and technical deep-dive discussions. Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from experienced team members, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups. For career growth at Taktile, this role will involve daytime ops duty and at some point joining an on-call rotation, so you need to have passion for owning systems end to end and grow your DevSecOps skills as well. Team's tech stack Backend: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic) Frontend: React, TypeScript Data: DynamoDB, Postgres Cloud: AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway) AI: LLM orchestration, tool-use frameworks, streaming execution Requirements Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in an hybrid environment requiring clear and effective communication. Strong English skills are also crucial to efficiently interacting with AI. Prior industry experience building full-stack web applications (this is not an entry-level position). Proficiency with React and TypeScript, and experience building rich, interactive user interfaces. Experience with Python back-end development, building and operating RESTful APIs, and working with databases. Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers. Wat ga je doen? Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen. Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals: Vormgeving; Webinarproducties; Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud; E-mail marketing; Social media; Deep dive in de analytics; Meedenken in plannen rondom AI. Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan. Met wie werk je samen? Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). items.title: Academic Dean for MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio
items.snippet: Location : 100% remote (Ohio residency required) Classification : Full-time, exempt Reports to : School Leader Pay Range : $40.00 - $48.00 per hour Welcome to Miaplaza! Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð Role Summary The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Instructional Staff Management Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting. Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers. Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback. Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback. Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals. Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences. Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations. Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed. Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes. Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law. Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together. Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns. Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track. Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas. Academic Data & Testing Coordination Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions. Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing. Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families. Professional Development Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data. Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team. Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities. Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues. Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations. Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments. Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices. Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â What We're Looking For Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026. Requirements: Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in education, educational leadership, or a related field preferred Valid Ohio teaching license and/or administrator license, or ability to obtain one, to be confirmed against current requirements At least 3 years of teaching experience At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role such as department chair, instructional coach, dean, or assistant principal Experience in virtual school settings or teaching online Experience supervising employees and conducting evaluations or performance reviews Comfort working in online learning environments and with learning management and student information systems The Ideal Candidate Brings: Experience administering or coordinating standardized testing and working with student assessment data Experience as a member of a founding team for a new school Compensation & Benefits The expected starting pay range is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour.
